{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgTJ5PSu494RhCqYjRhY4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015SWjHAc8xTJDtzWZPePXjJ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.190646/build/FxRates/cli/dispatch.py","content":"\"\"\"Command resolution and the mapping from raised errors to exit codes.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Sequence\n\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError, RejectedFile, UsageError\n\nCOMMAND_PACKAGE = \"cli.commands\"\n_COMMAND_NAME = re.compile(r\"[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\")\n_MAPPED_ERRORS = (OperationalError, UsageError, RejectedFile)\n\nHandler = Callable[[list[str]], int]\n\n\ndef execute(handler: Handler, args: Sequence[str]) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Call handler(args) and return its result; map a raised expected error to its exit code.\n\n    The error's message goes to stderr as one line. Nothing is written to stdout on failure.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        return handler(list(args))\n    except _MAPPED_ERRORS as exc:\n        message = \" \".join(str(exc).split())\n        print(f\"error: {message}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n\n\ndef resolve(name: str) -> Handler:\n    \"\"\"Return the run() of the cli.commands module named by the first argument.\"\"\"\n    if not _COMMAND_NAME.fullmatch(name):\n        raise UsageError(f\"unknown command {name!r}\")\n    module_name = f\"{COMMAND_PACKAGE}.{name}\"\n    try:\n        module = importlib.import_module(module_name)\n    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:\n        # Only a missing command module is a usage error; a broken import inside one propagates.\n        if exc.name == module_name:\n            raise UsageError(f\"unknown command {name!r}\") from None\n        raise\n    return module.run\n\n\ndef dispatch(argv: Sequence[str]) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Route argv to its command module and return the exit code.\"\"\"\n\n    def route(args: list[str]) -> int:\n        if not args:\n            raise UsageError(\"no command given\")\n        return resolve(args[0])(args[1:])\n\n    return execute(route, argv)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":11183,"cache_read_input_tokens":43890,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":11183},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"91b472b9-71ae-4aee-bd06-6e5bfb5f36cd","uuid":"8d23a5c7-3e59-4385-a901-073c7dd0265c","timestamp":"2026-10-27T19:29:24.095Z","request_id":"req_011CgTJ5P6pMromH7aKBqrFD","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_015SWjHAc8xTJDtzWZPePXjJ":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.190646/build/FxRates/cli/dispatch.py","content":"\"\"\"Command resolution and the mapping from raised errors to exit codes.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Sequence\n\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError, RejectedFile, UsageError\n\nCOMMAND_PACKAGE = \"cli.commands\"\n_COMMAND_NAME = re.compile(r\"[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\")\n_MAPPED_ERRORS = (OperationalError, UsageError, RejectedFile)\n\nHandler = Callable[[list[str]], int]\n\n\ndef execute(handler: Handler, args: Sequence[str]) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Call handler(args) and return its result; map a raised expected error to its exit code.\n\n    The error's message goes to stderr as one line. Nothing is written to stdout on failure.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        return handler(list(args))\n    except _MAPPED_ERRORS as exc:\n        message = \" \".join(str(exc).split())\n        print(f\"error: {message}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n\n\ndef resolve(name: str) -> Handler:\n    \"\"\"Return the run() of the cli.commands module named by the first argument.\"\"\"\n    if not _COMMAND_NAME.fullmatch(name):\n        raise UsageError(f\"unknown command {name!r}\")\n    module_name = f\"{COMMAND_PACKAGE}.{name}\"\n    try:\n        module = importlib.import_module(module_name)\n    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:\n        # Only a missing command module is a usage error; a broken import inside one propagates.\n        if exc.name == module_name:\n            raise UsageError(f\"unknown command {name!r}\") from None\n        raise\n    return module.run\n\n\ndef dispatch(argv: Sequence[str]) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Route argv to its command module and return the exit code.\"\"\"\n\n    def route(args: list[str]) -> int:\n        if not args:\n            raise UsageError(\"no command given\")\n        return resolve(args[0])(args[1:])\n\n    return execute(route, argv)\n"}}}
